REPAIRED FAILURE IN HYDRAULIC FLUID HOSE. ATTEMPTED TO TEST UPPER RAM PREVENTER AND BLIND RAM OBSERVING LEAK IN TEST PLUG 'O' RING. CONNECTED CUP TESTER WITH EXTENSION AND ATTEMPTED TO TEST AGAIN NO SUCCESS, OBSERVED THAT PROPESA COMPANY TEST CUP DOES NOT PACK.
REQUESTED ANOTHER TEST CUP FROM PROPESA COMPANY, INSTALLED NEW CUP AND ATTEMPTED TO TEST AGAIN NO SUCCESS, CUP DID NOT PACK. WAITED FOR VETCO COMPANY TEST PLUG AND INSTALLED IT. CURRENT PROGRESS 13-5/8"-10M BOPS TEST WITH 300PSI LOW AND 8000PSI HIGH: 25%
